decision.basis: visual preference of the JORN 160-day uniform field-capacity comparison
decision.stress_note: 0.30255 = 1.5 x 0.2017 (a rounded sensitivity value); it is the user's selected JORN setting, not a newly fitted parameter and not the earlier jointly fitted 0.20170581117963332

scope.applies_to: future JORN (NEON Jornada plot 004) soil-column runs that LOAD this preset explicitly
not: a MOAB default (MOAB keeps its own SR33-derived field capacity and properties)
a retroactive migration of frozen configs, source locks, restart identities or published results
scope.transpiration: T = 0 only in the current controlled experiments; this preset does not require T = 0 for future LEAF coupling

units.theta_evaporation_stress: volumetric fraction m3/m3 (a normalisation scale of the quadratic evaporation reduction; may exceed saturation)
units.evaporation_factor: dimensionless multiplier of the potential soil evaporation
units.conductivity_multiplier: dimensionless multiplier of ALL Ks, matrix K and interface K relative to the accepted SR33 values

preserved_from_accepted_jorn: saturation, residual content, Ks, matrix K and interface conductivities stay exactly the accepted SR33-derived JORN values; no conductivity or other retention value is recomputed when the field capacity is overridden
d_provenance: d = 0.0010239461376024856 came from the earlier joint fit of d and the evaporation stress at E = 1, with T = 0 and the old 6 kPa field capacity, to 53 JORN/MOAB 2025 dry-period observations; it is retained unchanged and is not re-fitted here

deferred.third_layer_wetting_discrepancy: the model 20-30 cm wetting at the January 2024 storm versus the 25.8 cm sensor is unresolved and deferred by user decision; all outputs and measurements are retained; no sensor, wetting-front or support-cause investigation, censoring or refit is based on it
